vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: The Vega worker JSON-parses attacker-controlled input and passes the resulting spec to vega.parse()/vega.View(), whose loader can dereference URL-backed data. Before the direct fix, secure mode inspected URLs only when spec.data was an array; a single spec.data object with data.url (including file://) and group-local marks[].data[].url reached the loader. The advisory describes this insufficient sanitization and the fix tests reproduce both bypass shapes, including file:///etc/passwd.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -S'vega.View' -- vega/ identifies 741e6c088bc43483003c33613d11e8cc0c029228 as the first write. That single-parent commit atomically added Vega support, including JSON.parse(source) followed by new vega.View(vega.parse(spec)); 9673f0aed169383c45c8141d5aa8707f432fce14 later added only the incomplete array-only secure-mode check, and d1c0250d6e5a2efcd54f8afb78cfe60bc37fd9d3 is a later path extraction/refactor.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has immediate parent 5545970cd46c8fcfdf2b7cbbadf97ec5e33378a8, and git ls-tree -r of that parent contains no vega/ tree, so the Vega URL-loading source-to-sink path is absent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: 741e6c088bc43483003c33613d11e8cc0c029228 is a one-parent, ordinary atomic feature commit, not a merge, revert, move, or squash aggregate; no member decomposition is applicable. The later d1c0250d6e5a2efcd54f8afb78cfe60bc37fd9d3 move does not replace the first-write BIC.

affected_fixed_release_membership.evidence: Repository ancestry shows v0.0.11 excludes the BIC, v0.0.12 includes both the BIC and the later incomplete sanitizer, v0.28.0 excludes f31093cd8a0a1d6999c43d560f62d1e82d59c77e, and v0.29.0 includes it. Thus the repository-supported bounds are first affected v0.0.12, last affected v0.28.0, first fixed v0.29.0; the CVE CNA record itself only supplies the non-specific affected range 0..<*.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: The published GHSA and CVE record both reference f31093cd8a0a1d6999c43d560f62d1e82d59c77e. Its diff against parent a7d70da836c981d1232cec64f9e3c6486b556aba directly adds rejection of object-form spec.data.url and marks[].data[].url, with regression tests for both disclosed paths.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object names Guillaume Grossetie <ggrossetie@gmail.com> as both author and committer, has subject 'resolves #54 add support for Vega', an empty body, and no trailers, bot identity, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI marker. The NOT_AI judgment relies only on this BIC object, not on later mitigation or fix commits.

findings: The advisory is live: CVE-2025-14896 is PUBLISHED in the CVE.org record and GHSA-5q5g-57mw-wmq6 has withdrawn_at=null.
The vulnerable source-to-sink path first appears in 741e6c088bc43483003c33613d11e8cc0c029228; its immediate parent has no Vega implementation.
The primary NOT_AI verdict, BIC, direct fix, and release boundaries are independently supported by the advisory and clone evidence.
